test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

SUSTAIN (V)
solution:
The correct answer is "**support**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sustain** means keeping** something alive for a long period** of time. 

 
 
• **Example**: *Ron **sustained** despite his peer pressure.*
 
 
 
• **Support** means **to endure something** with bravery.
 
 
• **Example:** *Luke **endured** his family's financial needs despite his meagre salary. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, support is the most appropriate synonym for sustain. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Believe** - to have faith in something or somebody.

 
 
• **Example**: *Harry **believed** his mother's stories to be true as a child. *
 
 
 
• **Weaken** - to become less strong. 
 
 
• **Example**: *Fever **weakened** Ted's body.*
 
 
 
• **Suspect** - to doubt someone.
 
 
• **Example:** *The police **suspect** William's gang for the burglary. *
